patch_description: This crossover retains the successful 12-edge CZ topology from the stronger inspiration program and removes the four harmful extra CZ links from the current candidate. It adds a globally shared post-entanglement RY mixing layer, borrowing the useful second rotation stage from the higher-margin prior architecture while requiring only one additional distinct parameter. The resulting three-parameter design balances robust separation, parameter economy, shallow depth, and symmetry-driven generalization.
